enchantment.paleenchants.insight.desc: More experience from mobs killed and blocks mined with this item.
enchantment.paleenchants.smashing.desc: Ores break into crushed ore (Create) or drop twice as much.
enchantment.paleenchants.smelting.desc: Mined blocks drop already smelted, as if by a furnace.
enchantment.paleenchants.soulbound.desc: Stays with you when you die. Each death may weaken it; higher levels are safer.
enchantment.paleenchants.vorpal.desc: Chance of a devastating strike, and of taking the head of what you kill.
